caption: the quiet week after the eclipses. next up: venus enters aquarius mar 1, mercury turns direct mar 3.

slides.headline: after two *eclipses*, the sky gives you a quiet week
slides.dek: four things, all of them gentle

slides.headline: the moon in *libra*: a good night to talk it through
slides.body: then scorpio from feb 24: feelings go deeper and quieter. read it as a mid-week check-in, not an interrogation.

slides.headline: *mercury* is still backing up, now in aquarius
slides.body: mercury retrograde runs until mar 3. old friends, old chats, old ideas. reply to the ones that matter.

slides.headline: a last quarter moon in *sagittarius* closes the month
slides.body: astrologers read a last quarter as clean-up time. one honest goodbye or one honest yes.

slides.headline: next monday, *venus* moves into aquarius
slides.body: love weather changes from careful to curious. use this week to finish the capricorn lesson: follow through.

slides.headline: quiet isn't boring. it's *room*.
slides.body: save this. text the one you've been meaning to.
